digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center support and capability guards
propositions: Epic-field contract validation must occur post-run and reject unverifiable reports rather than silently writing incorrect contracts
Capability call sites must be runtime-guarded with isinstance-primary-plus-hasattr-fallback pattern to prevent silent failures when transports lack required attributes
The inbound absence-probe port, its implementations, and the shared classifier were deleted as ruled dormant, with operator decisions recorded outside the repo on tickets f020 and e369
Capability-absent and capability-raised outcomes must be reported distinctly on bridge_alerts channel as designed skips versus actual failures, not swallowed or hard-failed
Three changes (f487b62b3c, 671fa77c88, b95c097fd4) landed to main with Verified+1 CI status and did not introduce new failures in the live DC harness, which was already red from a pre-existing cause
Python 3.12's isinstance-based capability detection with @runtime_checkable is unsafe for proxying transports that use __getattr__, requiring a hasattr fallback documented as divergence from ADR-0083
